content.short: SmithyDao is a decentralized gaming project built on Arbitrum that offers free-to-play games with online rewards for the best players.
content.description: SmithyDao operates on the Arbitrum network and features free-to-play, Web3-enabled games that reward skill and persistence. Players can compete in online matches without upfront costs, climbing a leaderboard where the most successful participants win rewards. The top-ranked players receive the $Magic token, an Arbitrum-native incentive. This approach combines approachable gameplay with on-chain rewards, inviting players to earn while they play and participate in a community-driven experience.
